columns.name: open_time
columns.comment: Bar open, UTC. Dedup key with symbol.

columns.name: close_time
columns.comment: Bar close, UTC. Used to detect unfinished bars.

columns.name: open
columns.comment: Cast from Binance string.

columns.name: high
columns.comment: Cast from Binance string.

columns.name: low
columns.comment: Cast from Binance string.

columns.name: close
columns.comment: Cast from Binance string.

columns.name: volume
columns.comment: Base asset volume.

columns.name: quote_volume
columns.comment: Quote asset (USDT) volume.

columns.name: num_trades
columns.comment: Trade count. 0 indicates an untraded minute.

columns.name: taker_buy_base
columns.comment: Taker buy base volume.

columns.name: log_return
columns.comment: ln(close/prev_close). NULL on a symbol's first bar.

columns.name: rolling_vol
columns.comment: stddev_samp(log_return) over a trailing 20-MINUTE window. NULL until 20 return observations exist.

columns.name: dollar_volume
columns.comment: close * volume. Approximate - prefer quote_volume, which is Binance's exact USDT turnover.

columns.name: range_pct
columns.comment: (high-low)/open. NULL if open <= 0.

columns.name: ingested_at
columns.comment: When this version was fetched. Dedup tie-break.

columns.name: source_host
columns.comment: Lineage: which Binance host served it.

columns.name: symbol
columns.comment: Trading pair.

columns.name: event_time
columns.comment: open_time of the flagged bar, UTC.

columns.name: rule
columns.comment: return_zscore | volume_zscore

columns.name: rule_direction
columns.comment: both (abs(z) > k) | upper (z > k). Returns are two-sided - a crash is as anomalous as a spike. Volume is upper-tail only: the lower tail was flagging untraded minutes as 'anomalously low volume', which is illiquidity, not an event.

columns.name: observed_value
columns.comment: The value actually scored - see observed_transform.

columns.name: observed_transform
columns.comment: none (log_return) | log1p (volume). Volume is log-transformed because a z-score on raw, right-skewed, non-negative volume puts its lower bound below zero.

columns.name: rolling_mean
columns.comment: Baseline mean over the trailing window, EXCLUDING this bar.

columns.name: rolling_std
columns.comment: Baseline sample stddev over the same window.

columns.name: zscore
columns.comment: (observed - rolling_mean) / rolling_std. Signed: negative means an unusually large DOWN move.

columns.name: close_price
columns.comment: Price context at the event.

columns.name: volume
columns.comment: RAW volume for context, untransformed.

columns.name: num_trades
columns.comment: Trade count context. 0 indicates an untraded minute.

columns.name: zscore_window_bars
columns.comment: Window length that produced this row.

columns.name: zscore_threshold
columns.comment: k that produced this row. Stored per-row so events from different parameter choices stay distinguishable.

columns.name: run_id
columns.comment: Lambda request id - correlates a row back to CloudWatch logs.

columns.name: run_at
columns.comment: ISO-8601 UTC. Kept as string: the JSON SerDe's timestamp handling is fussy, and parsing on read with from_iso8601_timestamp() is explicit and reliable.

columns.name: check_name
columns.comment: Named check_name, not check - CHECK is a reserved word in Athena.

columns.name: severity
columns.comment: fail (blocks the pipeline) | warn (recorded and alerted, does not block).

columns.name: observed
columns.comment: The measured value. NULL when not measurable - e.g. freshness on an empty Silver layer, where the raw value is infinite and infinity is not valid JSON.

columns.name: detail
columns.comment: Human-readable explanation of what the check protects against.

rows.detail: newest bar age in minutes; ~4.4 min of this is structural (M-025)
consecutive bars must strictly advance; a violation means the dedup key or the ordering is broken
high must be the max and low the min of the bar; a violation means upstream corruption or a positional-mapping bug in cast_bars()
a zero or negative price makes log_return undefined and poisons every downstream aggregate
24361 rows of 24480 possible (17 symbols x 24h)
a symbol missing entirely means ingestion is failing for it silently
untraded minutes are normal for illiquid pairs (SHIBUSDT measured at 1.89%); a large jump suggests a degraded feed
missing minutes break the trailing-window assumption; the 15-bar ingestion overlap should normally backfill any single missed run
